actors.name: Gustavo
actors.private_context: Gustavo is a mid-tier performer selling invoice-automation software. He has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He plans to cold-email them this week. His usual booking rate is about one call per sixty cold emails.

actors.name: Procurement Leads
actors.private_context: Forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. Each receives many cold emails and may or may not be interested in invoice-automation software. Their collective response rate is approximately one discovery call per sixty cold emails.

shared_context: Gustavo has a list of forty procurement leads at mid-market manufacturers in the Pacific Northwest. He will send cold emails to them this week (starting 2026-08-03). Each lead can respond to schedule a discovery call. The end of the month is 2026-08-31.

starting_events.description: Gustavo begins sending cold emails to the forty procurement leads.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty procurement leads actually scheduled or agreed to a discovery call with Gustavo before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
